run_backend_with_caching: run a function with the Backend class using cached mode to cache results on disk
check_cache_status: check if a Backend step has a cached result using has_cache or _cache_status
clear_backend_cache: clear the cached result for a Backend step using clear_cache to delete disk and RAM cache
submit_slurm_job: submit a function to a Slurm cluster using the Slurm backend with partition and constraint parameters
load_cached_error: load a cached error from StepPaths using load_cached_error to inspect previously failed step results
